info.title: API.SH: Lululemon
info.description: The Lululemon API from API.SH: public Lululemon data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A lululemon category's products (Women's Leggings, Men's Joggers, Bags...): id, name, link, category, price range, sale price, on-sale flag, availability, every colour with its price and image, sizes, activities and highlights, with the category title, description, breadcrumbs and total. Sort with `sort`. Filter by passing an option's `path` from `facets` as `path`: every filter group the page offers is listed (size, fit, length, neckline, type, colour, activity, collection, fabric, features, climate...) with its product count. Page with `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lululemon-category

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Category link or path, e.g. `/c/women-leggings/n1oxc7`, or a facet option's `path` to apply that filter.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Store and language: `en-us` (US, USD; default), `en-ca` (Canada, CAD) or `fr-ca`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One lululemon product: name, category and breadcrumbs, gender, price range, sale price, collections, activities, highlights, trending and best-selling colours, every style with its design intent, features, fabric, fit and each colour's prices and images, and every SKU (size, colour, inseam, list and sale price, in stock, low stock, final sale). Use `reviews_id` with /lululemon/v1/reviews.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lululemon-product

get.description:
A lululemon product's reviews: rating, title, text, date, nickname, verified-buyer and staff flags, badges, likes, fit details (fits, size purchased, usual size), photos, lululemon's reply and comments, with the total. Sort, filter by star rating and search the review text. Page with `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lululemon-reviews

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Product link or id (or pass `reviews_id` instead).

parameters.name: reviews_id
parameters.description: The product's `reviews_id` from /lululemon/v1/product or a listing (skips the product lookup).

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars (1-5).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only reviews that mention these words.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
